evals.name: mixed-lint-output
evals.prompt: Process this lint report and apply the appropriate fixes. The lint output is in lint-report.txt and the source files are in the same fixture directory. For OBVIOUS items, fix them directly in the files. For AMBIGUOUS items, do NOT modify code — produce a markdown file `escalation.md` summarizing each ambiguous item with rationale and recommendation. Save modified source files and `escalation.md` to the outputs directory.
evals.expected_output: Source files contain the auto-fixed obvious items. An escalation.md file lists the ambiguous items with 'Why ambiguous' explanations and severity (CRITICAL/MAJOR/MINOR).
expectations: src/user.js no longer contains the unused import line `const path = require('path');`.
src/user.js comment typo 'recieves' is corrected to 'receives'.
An `escalation.md` file is produced in the outputs directory.
escalation.md mentions the style/naming preference issue (camelCase vs snake_case) as ambiguous.
escalation.md mentions the architectural suggestion ('consider extracting validateOrder') as ambiguous.
escalation.md does NOT classify the unused-import or typo as ambiguous (those should have been auto-fixed).
src/order.js was not modified to extract validateOrder (ambiguous items are not auto-applied).
DISCRIMINATING: escalation.md uses the canonical 'Why ambiguous' label (verbatim).
DISCRIMINATING: escalation.md assigns canonical severity (CRITICAL, MAJOR, or MINOR) to at least one ambiguous item.
DISCRIMINATING: escalation.md uses the canonical 'OBVIOUS' / 'AMBIGUOUS' classification labels (verbatim, uppercase).

evals.name: mixed-pr-review-comments
evals.prompt: A reviewer left comments on this PR. The comments are in `review-comments.md` and the changed file is `src/auth.js`. Process the comments: auto-apply OBVIOUS fixes to `src/auth.js` and produce `escalation.md` for AMBIGUOUS items. Save the modified `src/auth.js` and `escalation.md` to the outputs directory.
evals.expected_output: src/auth.js is patched to fix the null-check bug (OBVIOUS). escalation.md lists the design-pattern suggestion and the hedged 'maybe extract' comment as ambiguous, each with a 'Why ambiguous' explanation.
expectations: src/auth.js contains a null/undefined check on `user` before `user.id` is dereferenced (OBVIOUS bug fix applied).
escalation.md exists in the outputs directory.
escalation.md mentions the 'consider using strategy pattern' comment as AMBIGUOUS.
escalation.md mentions the 'maybe extract password validation' hedged comment as AMBIGUOUS.
escalation.md provides a 'Why ambiguous' rationale for at least one item.
src/auth.js does NOT have a strategy pattern refactor applied (ambiguous suggestion was correctly not auto-applied).
src/auth.js does NOT have password validation extracted into a separate function (hedged suggestion was correctly not auto-applied).
DISCRIMINATING: escalation.md uses the canonical 'Why ambiguous' label (verbatim).
DISCRIMINATING: escalation.md assigns canonical severity (CRITICAL, MAJOR, or MINOR) to at least one ambiguous item.
DISCRIMINATING: escalation.md notes hedging language ('maybe', 'consider', 'could') as a reason at least one item is ambiguous (per the skill's ALWAYS-AMBIGUOUS rule).
